name: Tru-Shine

reviews.text: I was thrilled with my experience with Tru-Shine. It was easy to book, the rates were clear and up front, the cleaner came right on time, was delightful, thoroughly cleaned everything we discussed. I have tried other cleaners before and have never felt like my home got thoroughly cleaned. I paid more for this clean than I have paid in the past but I got way more bang for my buck with Tru-Shine than any other cleaner I've had before. I will definitely be a repeat customer. I felt comfortable while she was here and the results are amazing. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Erin McDaniel

reviews.text: Fantastic work!  Highly recommend and greatly appreciative of the services they provide.  My move out clean was totally worth it.  Would 10/10 use their service again.
reviews.author: Bek Roxxx

reviews.text: I hired them for a move out clean after a no show from another company, they were able to squeeze me in even with the ice storm, it was highly appreciated.  They cleaned the whole place in 4 hours and it smelled and looked amazing!  Marina was so good at communicating and very friendly.  I will definitely hire them again!
reviews.author: Jennifer Chan

reviews.text: Absolutely recommend Tru-shines services. I can’t get over how clean everything is. They did such a great job and they were a joy to visit with. My toddler loved them and they were so kind to him while he hovered 😭 I can’t recommend them enough
reviews.author: Amanda Riley

reviews.text: The help was amazing! Both my roommates were bedridden with the flu and I had recently injured my hand, the house became a mess very quickly with no one able to clean. But Tru-Shine did an amazing job cleaning every inch of the house and even doing our dishes and helping me load my laundry. I’m am so grateful for all the help and will be recommending to all friends and family.
reviews.author: Isabella D
